subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool `accountId` infer a single enabled configured account across channel plugins, and should the current linked PR be repaired as that implementation path?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but changing default fallback behavior for multi-account setups is compatibility-sensitive and the current candidate PR is conflicting and proof-limited.

options.title: Repair and review the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85671 as the implementation candidate after resolving conflicts, confirming fallback policy, and requiring real or strong scenario proof.

options.title: Open a narrower replacement fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting PR and implement the same shared resolver in a fresh focused branch with targeted tests and docs.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection required
options.body: Reject automatic inference and update docs/errors so omitted `accountId` never appears to succeed in multi-account disabled-default setups.

recommendation.title: Repair and review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85671 as the implementation candidate after resolving conflicts, confirming fallback policy, and requiring real or strong scenario proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already provided the most specific follow-up direction on this issue and have recent history on the shared account/channel helper area.
